usageNote: 露营活动常见指示语，意思是主办方不提供帐篷，你得自己背一顶来！缩写BYOT超流行。

examples.en: The music festival is BYOT — bring your own tent and claim your spot early!
examples.zh: 这个音乐节要自带帐篷，早点去占位！

examples.en: Just a heads up: it's bring your own tent, so pack light but don't forget the poles.
examples.zh: 提醒一下：要自带帐篷，行李轻装但别忘了帐篷杆。
